pages.text: Rambutan grows on a Rambutan tree, which can be found in the Nether Wasteland biome. When eaten, it gives a Regeneration effect, but it will cause little damage. You can also make a shield, carpet and helmet out of Rambutan.

pages.title: Rambutan Items
pages.text: The helmet will produce spines if you start shaking your head quickly. The carpet is like thorns on the ground. Defending with a shield, the attacker will take damage.
